contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Independent primary check against SRC-0004 (Canning–Larson, arXiv:2208.02357v2) Lemma 10.6: deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f and deg(\omega_C\otimes W_f^\vee(\Gamma))=4f+n-2g-14. For balanced F=O(4)\oplus O(5) at (g,n)=(6,6) and f=4 this is 16+6-12-14=-4. On a smooth curve any line bundle of negative degree has H^0=0, so H^0(\omega_C\otimes W_4^\vee(\Gamma))=0 for every degree-six \Gamma and the f=4 summand of the Serre-dual evaluation obstruction vanishes identically. This matches the packet CE convention W_f:=(O_{P(E^\vee)}(2)\otimes\gamma^*O(-f))|_C and justifies the packet’s exclusive focus on the f_2=5 summand for the evaluation-failure locus Z (where deg(\omega\otimes W_5^\vee(\Gamma))=0). Compatible with corroborated FND-0061: FND-0062 only asserts vanishing of the f=4 H^0 summand, not a complete scheme-theoretic identification of the CE failure locus. Not a merge with FND-0037 despite the finding record’s erroneous candidate_key/equivalence_group label FND-0037 (that corroborated finding concerns the mixed R^1 local system on M_{6,6}\to M_{6,5}). Distinct from FND-0055 (W_5 vanishing on an open U is not a purity theorem). Merge target: none. Promote from candidate to corroborated on this independent primary-source verification of the degree/-4/H^0=0 calculation.
